exports.getTraconPrefixes = getTraconPrefixes;
exports.getTraconSuffix = getTraconSuffix;
exports.getLongestTraconPrefix = getLongestTraconPrefix;
exports.getFacilityByCallsign = getFacilityByCallsign;
function getTraconPrefixes(tracon) {
    if (typeof tracon.properties?.prefix === 'object' && Array.isArray(tracon.properties.prefix))
        return tracon.properties.prefix;
    return [];
}
function getTraconSuffix(tracon) {
    if (typeof tracon.properties?.suffix === 'string')
        return tracon.properties.suffix;
    return null;
}
function getLongestTraconPrefix(callsign, prefixes) {
    return prefixes.reduce((matched, prefix) => callsign.startsWith(prefix) && prefix.length > matched.length ? prefix : matched, '');
}
const facilitiesMap = {
    OBS: 0,
    FSS: 1,
    DEL: 2,
    GND: 3,
    RMP: -3,
    TWR: 4,
    APP: 5,
    CTR: 6,
};
function getFacilityByCallsign(callsign) {
    let postfix = callsign.split('_').at(-1);
    if (postfix === 'DEP')
        postfix = 'APP';
    return facilitiesMap[postfix] ?? -1;
}
